summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 26/27 pytest PASS. New endpoints /api/rides/track (auto-create + append + stats), /api/rides/{id}/points (asc by ts, user-scoped, no _id leak), /api/billing/status (defaults is_pro:false), /api/billing/webhook (invalid sig → 400) all PASS. Regression suite (19 tests from iter1) all PASS. ONE BACKEND BUG FOUND: /api/billing/checkout-session returns HTTP 500 (crash) instead of 400/503 when Stripe is placeholder-configured — this violates the explicit acceptance criteria. Root cause: guard at server.py:636 only checks empty strings, but .env holds non-empty placeholder values ('sk_test_emergent'/'price_placeholder'), so control falls through to stripe.checkout.Session.create which raises AuthenticationError uncaught → FastAPI returns 500. Frontend: register→dashboard works. Pair screen shows SIM badge on web, Start Scan streams simulated devices, PAIR marks device CONNECTED. Map tab renders radar-grid fallback (native-map.web.tsx) and shows Broadcast + active-riders-count. REC button (record-ride-toggle) starts recording and shows 'Recording started · GPS active' banner (browser geolocation on web worked in test env). Groups: create-group-open-button opens modal (name field is 'new-group-name-input', submit is 'confirm-create-group-button'). Profile → Rider Pro row navigates to /rider-pro (rider-pro-screen), shows hero, $4.99, 7-DAY FREE TRIAL text, 5 perk rows, start-trial-button. Tapping the trial button DOES surface the rider-pro-error banner with 'Error 500' — no client crash — meeting the front-end acceptance criterion, but the underlying backend HTTP status is 500 (not 503). PTT screen loads, sign out works. Deprecated packages detected: none new in iter2 (still shadow* → boxShadow warning and props.pointerEvents warning from iter1).

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 (Internal Server Error) crash instead of the required 400/503 clean error when Stripe is placeholder-configured. The guard at server.py:636 (`if not STRIPE_SECRET_KEY or not STRIPE_RIDER_PRO_PRICE_ID`) does NOT trip because both env vars contain non-empty placeholder strings ('sk_test_emergent' / 'price_placeholder'). Control reaches stripe.checkout.Session.create(...) which raises stripe._error.AuthenticationError('Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent'); no try/except → FastAPI converts it to 500. Fix options: (1) treat known placeholders as unconfigured, e.g. `if STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in (None,'','sk_test_emergent') or STRIPE_RIDER_PRO_PRICE_ID in (None,'','price_placeholder'): raise HTTPException(503, 'Stripe not configured...')`, OR (2) wrap `session = stripe.checkout.Session.create(...)` in `try/except stripe.error.StripeError as e: raise HTTPException(503, f'Stripe error: {e.user_message or str(e)}')`. Recommended: do both.

integration_issues.issue: The error banner correctly appears and prevents a client crash, but message shown is only 'Error 500' because backend returns bare 500 with no detail. Once backend fix returns 503 with detail (e.g. 'Stripe not configured...'), the same banner will display the user-friendly message automatically (rider-pro.tsx already uses e?.message).

rca_of_issue: Bug: POST /api/billing/checkout-session returns 500 instead of 503 when Stripe misconfigured. Reproduction: (1) POST to /api/billing/checkout-session with valid auth token and `{"return_url": "https://intercom-hub-3.preview.emergentagent.com/rider-pro"}` while STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_emergent and STRIPE_RIDER_PRO_PRICE_ID=price_placeholder. (2) Observe 500 Internal Server Error in response and stripe._error.AuthenticationError in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. Root cause: server.py:636 guard `if not STRIPE_SECRET_KEY or not STRIPE_RIDER_PRO_PRICE_ID` evaluates False because both env vars are non-empty strings. Execution proceeds to stripe.checkout.Session.create at line 648 which authenticates with the fake key and raises AuthenticationError that is not caught. FastAPI's default handler converts unhandled exceptions to HTTP 500. Mitigation: explicitly detect known placeholder values and/or wrap the Stripe SDK call in try/except stripe.error.StripeError → raise HTTPException(503, detail). See action_items[0].
